build_TransformerModel: build a TransformerModel encoder or decoder with configurable layers, heads, and embedding dimensions
generate_TransformerModel_generate: generate text sequences using greedy or sampled decoding with optional source encoder context
generate_TransformerModel_generate_beam: generate text using beam search decoding with configurable beam size and length penalty
create_MultiHeadAttention: create a MultiHeadAttention layer with optional xformers efficient attention for self or cross attention
create_TransformerFFN: create a TransformerFFN feed-forward network with configurable hidden dimension and gelu or relu activation
